# cudaprof verify-capture validates capture completeness receipts against the strict gate.

exec cudaprof verify-capture good.json
stdout 'good.json: PASS \(run_completeness=complete, activity_records=24\)'

exec cudaprof verify-capture -json good.json
stdout '"status": "PASS"'
stdout '"qualified": true'

! exec cudaprof verify-capture partial.json
stdout 'partial.json: HOLD'
stderr 'run_completeness is "partial", want "complete"'
stderr 'unqualified_generations is 1, want 0'

! exec cudaprof verify-capture good.json a2_cupti_unknown.log a5_illegal_addr.json
stdout 'good.json: PASS'
stdout 'a2_cupti_unknown.log: HOLD'
stdout 'a5_illegal_addr.json: HOLD'
stderr 'CUPTI_ERROR_UNKNOWN'
stderr 'an illegal memory access'

-- good.json --
{
  "capture_success": true,
  "run_completeness": "complete",
  "target_exit_code": 0,
  "collector_finalized": true,
  "unqualified_generations": 0,
  "activity_records": 24
}
-- partial.json --
{
  "capture_success": true,
  "run_completeness": "partial",
  "target_exit_code": 0,
  "collector_finalized": true,
  "unqualified_generations": 1,
  "activity_records": 8
}

{"capture_success":false,"target_exit_code":1,"collector_finalized":false,"activity_records":0,"run_completeness":"failed","unqualified_generations":1,"capture_error":"cupti_unavailable: cuptiActivityRegisterCallbacks: CUPTI_ERROR_UNKNOWN"}
target exited with status 1
